method: Direct visual inspection of all 31 original framebuffer PNGs; roster 07–17 independently reviewed by delegated agent; byte hashes and PNG decoding verified.
limitations: Synthetic keyboard input via XSendEvent; no physical mouse or gamepad validation.
Runner reported audio disabled because ALSA device was unavailable; no audio listening validation.
Snapshots verify observed states, not every intermediate input frame or continuous audio timing.
CI source commit 4f1631f; later source changes require separate equivalence assessment.
